artifact_type: declarative proposal, not an executable training runner
user_submission_mode: user will submit the two existing CSV files manually

common.reference_transform: Frozen parser semantics; fresh fold-train MCMP support3 encoder for numeric29/guard only; raw12 stateless; fit all vocabularies/selectors/transforms within the relevant training partition
common.numeric41: same global29+raw12 definitions; log1p then training-only StandardScaler; fixed 1/sqrt(41) block weight, including NN/FM numeric branch
common.sample_weights: (N_train/n_class)^0.5; normalize sample mean to1; computed from relevant training labels only; unweighted evaluation
common.linear_model: lbfgs; L2; max_iter=3000; tol=1e-5; C from family grid; fail on ConvergenceWarning; no outer-valid early stopping
common.folds_and_classes: retain all rows, original target/class order/canonical groups; no relabeling or deletion of conflicting groups
common.seeds: model42 fixed, not searched; no repeated seed picking

fusion.half_h1_guarded_mean: 0.5*new_model_probability + 0.5*H1_probability; if reference MCMP symbolic vector is numeric-zero and the relevant H1 training partition contains no numeric-zero symbolic row, replace with exact H1 probability
fusion.H1: fixed existing recipe: fold-train mRMR + global29 + raw12, XGBoost200/depth3/lr0.1/model seed42/weight alpha0.5; refit within each applicable new split
fusion.cached_predictions: may share exactly matching training IDs/groups/labels/source/config across candidates; never reuse an old model that saw a current validation group

validation.mode: proposal: sealed outer5 x inner3 grouped nested search
validation.split_admission: fixed splitter implementation/version and input hashes; all26 classes in every train/valid partition; group crossing0; fail rather than searching split seeds for a favorable score
validation.selection: within each outer-training partition evaluate every candidate on pooled inner OOF; choose highest unweighted26-class macro-F1; exact ties within1e-12 prefer standalone then base_trial_id lexicographically
validation.outer_refit: fit the selected new base on all outer-training rows; apply selected fusion using H1 trained on same outer-training rows
validation.report: one full6201-row outer OOF for the entire search procedure, not a claimed score for one globally fixed winning architecture; no partial outer scores released during search
validation.baseline: refit frozen best algorithm on identical new outer partitions: H1 + C10, C10 bias learned on inner C10 OOF, then geometric supportguard
validation.baseline_subfit_reuse: 15 inner C10 fits and5 outer C10 fits,5 outer H1 fits; inner H1 anchor15 fits are distinct
validation.old_data_warning: Changing split seed does not make an already analyzed cohort independent; result remains development evidence affected by prior design choices
validation.final_deployment: after separate approval, select final configuration using the frozen inner-search procedure on all training data; current submission files stay untouched

proposed_promotion_gate.primary: new outer pooled macro-F1 >= same-new-split best-algorithm baseline +0.005
proposed_promotion_gate.integrity: all identity/hash/group/fold checks pass; all fits converged or completed fixed budgets; no malformed output; effective device/settings verified
proposed_promotion_gate.status_if_pass: candidate for frozen replay/robustness review, NOT automatic independent-validation claim or automatic submission
proposed_promotion_gate.note: Thresholds are proposed practical rules, not statistical guarantees; freeze before any run. Logloss/rescue/damage/uncertainty are reported separately.

budget.excludes: preprocessing work from classifier-fit count; failed attempts, later reproducibility runs, runtime pilot costs, optional extensions
budget.resource_gate: estimate actual matrix/optimizer/batch memory before each fit; no implicit CPU fallback; changing limits/grid after reading scores invalidates pre-registration

families.novelty: 원자료의 유효 단백질 위치를 유전자·변이종류별 구간으로 묶음

fixed.position_source: frozen mcmp_repr.safe_site only; use valid start coordinate; unresolved remains unknown

families.risk: 구간 경계가 임의적이며 가까운 위치가 같은 기능이라는 보장은 없음

families.novelty: 희귀 세부 특성이 전체 벡터 정규화에서 일반 특성을 약화시키는 문제를 별도 블록으로 다룸

fixed.representation: B0 and B1 as separate blocks
fixed.symbolic_transform: independent train-fitted sublinear TFIDF L2 per block; concatenate B0 and w*B1 without a second joint L2 normalization

families.risk: 희귀 특성 추가는 신호 확보와 잡음 증가를 함께 일으킬 수 있음; support1은 본 그리드에서 제외

families.novelty: 공통 softmax 대신 26개 암종 대 나머지 판별 및 암종별 특성 강조

fixed.nb_scope: training labels only within each fit; plain OVR control uses r=1
fixed.features: train-fitted TFIDF multiplied by class-specific r; numeric41 appended without NB reweighting
fixed.output: normalize 26 independent predict_proba positive-class scores; not claimed calibrated

families.risk: 작은 클래스의 통계 과적합; 1개 pipeline당 binary model 26개

families.novelty: 희소 변이 특성을 fold-train에서 학습한 저차원 공동발생 요인으로 표현

fixed.input: train-fitted B0 TFIDF; nonnegative input for NMF
fixed.nmf: init=nndsvda; solver=cd; beta_loss=frobenius; max_iter=1000; tol=1e-4; random_state=42; no silent convergence failure
fixed.latent_scaling: train-only StandardScaler then fixed block weight 1/sqrt(rank)

families.risk: 희귀 driver 정보 손실 가능; 잠재 요인은 생물학적 경로나 활성의 증거가 아님

families.novelty: 희소 특성의 쌍별 상호작용을 저차원 인자로 공유해 학습

fixed.symbolic_transform: row L2-normalized binary features; missing flags preserved
fixed.learner: proposed 26-logit second-order FM with class-specific factors + numeric41 linear branch
fixed.implementation: new multiclass adaptation; not a claim that libFM offers this exact ready-made interface

families.risk: 높은 변이 수에 따른 상호작용 수 증가; 통계적 상호작용을 생물학적 인과로 해석하지 않음

families.novelty: 미리 만든 희소 집계 대신 개별 annotation token의 순서 없는 집합을 학습

token_fields: log1p(valid start position) plus unknown-position flag
fixed.gene_vocabulary: fit on training token genes with canonical-group support>=2; remaining genes use UNK without dropping tokens
fixed.position_scaling: training-fold statistics only; no protein length or DNA context invented
fixed.architecture: two-layer token MLP; pooled embedding + numeric41; 26-way softmax
fixed.optimizer: AdamW; learning_rate=0.001; weight_decay=0.01; epochs=60; batch_rows=32; random_seed=42
fixed.sqrt_sum: sum token embeddings / sqrt(max(1,token_count)); empty set gets zero pooled vectors
fixed.token_preservation: chunked aggregation, not token truncation; preserve repeated annotations; no O(N^2) attention

families.risk: 6201행에서 신경망 과적합 가능성이 크며 새로운 GPU 구현/재현 검사가 필요

excluded_from_core: more posthoc class bias / unrestricted classwise stacking
pair specialist prioritized using conflicting-label groups
support1 fine features without a separate memory/dilution plan
invented DNA trinucleotide signatures, CNV, protein sequence or functional labels absent from inputs
later_separate_protocols: Broad curated pathway view only after rule/license/gene mapping/version/coverage review; no matched external patient labels
protein relative-coordinate or pretrained sequence model only if valid reference mapping and input provenance exist
seed robustness and genuine untouched external cohort confirmation; never choose the better seed result

references.previous_experiments: GOAL055_STRATEGY.md and named parent audit JSON files
references.evidence_limit: Methods motivate hypotheses; none establish a Macro-F1 gain on this dataset
